observations: Simultaneous admissions serialize at the queue high-water mark; accepted work drains to the low-water mark.
Three injected operational process failures pause admissions without consuming execution quota for blocked requests.
Cooldown requires an actual successful mission; waiting alone does not clear failures.
A real worker receives SIGKILL after its evaluate checkpoint; restart records unknown outcome, waits and resumes its exact durable mission.
Existing API/MCP scopes, quotas, forecasting, club and encrypted backup recovery remain covered.
limits: Fixed feedback policy, not learned thresholds.
Queued adaptive missions only; no global scheduler or CPU/cost controller.
Tests are controlled experiments, not production availability or wellbeing/PVS measurements.
No production failures or storage pressure were injected.
corrected_test_harness_issues: Unit probe test initially mixed simulated and real clocks; the clock is now held consistently.
MCP test initially omitted the existing required text/event-stream Accept value.
The historical v5 migration fixture now removes v11 tables when simulating a pre-v6 database.
